query_strategy.pubmed_query: (("sertraline"[MeSH Terms] OR "sertraline"[Substance Name] OR "sertraline"[Title/Abstract])) AND ("Lactation"[MeSH Terms] OR "Breast Feeding"[MeSH Terms] OR "Milk, Human"[MeSH Terms] OR lactat*[Title/Abstract] OR breastfeed*[Title/Abstract] OR breastfed[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Placenta"[MeSH Terms] OR "Milk, Human"[MeSH Terms] OR "Fetal Blood"[MeSH Terms] OR "Drug Levels"[Title/Abstract] OR concentration*[Title/Abstract] OR transfer[Title/Abstract] OR exposure[Title/Abstract])
limitations: Curated prototype query strategy, not a validated systematic-review search.
MeSH plus title/abstract terms includes unindexed recent records. Drug synonyms and imperfect indexing can still be missed.
Animal, in vitro, modeling and human records may be returned. Preserve study type; never call predicted exposure measured human exposure.

safety.scope: Public evidence and resource navigation; not individual treatment or eligibility decisions.
rules: Do not infer safety, drug identity, or absence of evidence from missing or empty results.
Do not provide doses, missed-dose plans, schedules, tapers or personal start/stop/change decisions.
Separate source findings, monitoring recommendations, exposure measurements and causal claims.
Call route_parent_question before parent-facing chat; urgent concerns take precedence over retrieval.
Do not collect identifiable histories or submit reports, comments or enrollment applications.

payload.disclaimer: Informational only; not medical advice. Compiled from public NIH/NLM/FDA data, which may be incomplete or out of date. Patients should talk to a clinician, pharmacist or poison control before starting, stopping or changing any medication.
